legend: Lenny had an n × m matrix of positive integers. He loved the matrix so much, because each row of the matrix was sorted in non-decreasing order. For the same reason he calls such matrices of integers lovely.

One day when Lenny was at school his little brother was playing with Lenny's matrix in his room. He erased some of the entries of the matrix and changed the order of some of its columns. When Lenny got back home he was very upset. Now Lenny wants to recover his matrix.

Help him to find an order for the columns of the matrix so that it's possible to fill in the erased entries of the matrix to achieve a lovely matrix again. Note, that you can fill the erased entries of the matrix with any integers.
input: The first line of the input contains two positive integers n and m (1 ≤ n·m ≤ 105). Each of the next n lines contains m space-separated integers representing the matrix. An integer -1 shows an erased entry of the matrix. All other integers (each of them is between 0 and 109 inclusive) represent filled entries.
output: If there exists no possible reordering of the columns print -1. Otherwise the output should contain m integers p1, p2, ..., pm showing the sought permutation of columns. So, the first column of the lovely matrix will be p1-th column of the initial matrix, the second column of the lovely matrix will be p2-th column of the initial matrix and so on.

legend.ai: Lenny 有一个 n × m 的正整数矩阵。他非常喜欢这个矩阵，因为矩阵的每一行都按非递减顺序排列。出于同样的原因，他将这样的整数矩阵称为可爱的矩阵。
有一天，Lenny 在学校时，他的弟弟在房间里摆弄 Lenny 的矩阵。他擦去了矩阵中的一些元素，并改变了其中一些列的顺序。Lenny 回到家后非常生气。现在，Lenny 想要恢复他的矩阵。
请帮助他找出一种矩阵列的排列顺序，使得可以填入矩阵中被擦除的元素，从而再次得到一个漂亮矩阵。注意，你可以用任意整数填充被擦除的元素。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个正整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n·m ≤ 10^5）。接下来的 n 行中，每行包含 m 个以空格分隔的整数，表示该矩阵。整数 -1 表示矩阵中被擦除的元素。所有其他整数（每个都在 0 到 10^9 之间，包含边界）表示已经填入的元素。

output.ai: 如果不存在可行的列重排方式，请输出 -1。否则，输出 m 个整数 p1，p2，...，pm，表示所需的列排列。因此，漂亮矩阵的第一列应为初始矩阵的第 p1 列，漂亮矩阵的第二列应为初始矩阵的第 p2 列，依此类推。
